ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical triage and health data analytics platform optimized for low-bandwidth rural settings, featuring rPPG vital sign extraction via standard smartphone cameras.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery; Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions
ideas.title: AshaPulse: Offline-First Multilingual Rural Health Triage
ideas.track: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rPPG camera sensing and multilingual triage with offline-first capabilities, directly mirroring architectures that win healthcare hackathons like mediscan-ai.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent platform that aggregates local senior health data and mental health indicators to coordinate social micro-outings and match volunteer drivers.
ideas.problem_statement: New ways and platforms to support mental health; Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks
ideas.title: MindBridge AI: Community Senior Health & Mental Outing Coordinator
ideas.track: New ways and platforms to support mental health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by targeting social isolation among seniors with an actionable, demonstrated matching engine, utilizing the exact architectural concept of Vanderbilt Global Good winner Outreach.

ideas.pitch: A smartphone-based posture and mobility screening tool that uses computer vision pose estimation to detect early musculoskeletal and neurological risks in children.
ideas.problem_statement: Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks; Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
ideas.title: VisionRisk: Pediatric Postural & Biomechanical Risk Screener
ideas.track: Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy computer vision engineering (MediaPipe Pose + XGBoost) analogous to CricketVision_AI, proving deep technical execution within a tight window.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that audits electronic health record summaries and insurance pre-authorizations to prevent care denial bias in underserved populations.
ideas.problem_statement: Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions; Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks
ideas.title: ClaimAudit: Multi-Agent Insurance Authorization & Bias Auditor
ideas.track: Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on Google Code Cure winner architecture (claim-bias-evaluator), appealing to judges looking for complex agentic workflows and algorithmic fairness.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-interactive AI chatbot that maps symptom queries from rural callers to predict localized disease outbreaks and schedule community immunizations.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery; Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks
ideas.title: GramVani: Voice-First Rural Outbreak & Vaccination Tracker
ideas.track: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scales the proven rural health awareness pattern of SAGACITY into an active predictive outbreak dashboard that health administrators can visualize live.
